title: Prepare the Git-sync S1 decision package for Greg (read-only)
outcome: Prepare the Git-sync S1 decision package for Greg (read-only)
acceptance: A holder note gives Greg concrete STORE-FORMAT options for S1's local progress, receipt and import-mapping storage: exact tables and columns, durable vs rebuildable, and whether each option needs full-store migration across the live stores, with counts and costs. It cites docs/features/git-task-sync.md and the current src/storage schema.

A holder note gives concrete options for the separate DATA-ONLY commit validation path (git-task-sync.md, 'Data commits and source landing policy'), including the no-exception option, and names the exact authority-text passages any option would change and the approval route each needs.

A holder note splits S1 exchange (w-42885a9ab4f4), and its follow-on w-65fb79ead0c3, into evaluator-checkable slices with criteria, and maps the brief's required implementation cases ('Implementation and validation boundary') to a slice-by-slice test matrix.

A holder note inventories the local and remote setup Greg needs to observe the workflow on a second machine (remote, branch, credentials boundary, per-host Engram home, TermAl and agent topology), stating what is shipped versus required, and records TermAl's design input (main-checkout serialization with gated roots and live turns, and the notification route) attributed to its TermAl source.

No S1 or S1-follow-on implementation item is claimed, no exchange or reconciliation code is written, no durable store format is changed, no remote is enabled and no agents are connected; the deferral stands until Greg's explicit go.

completion.summary: Git-sync S1 decision package delivered to Greg (read-only research). Storage options A/B/C with tables, columns, migration consequences and store sizes; data-only validation P0/P1/P2 with exact authority passages and approval route; S1/follow-on slices E1-E4, R1/R2, H1/H2 with the 23-case matrix; second-machine setup inventory with TermAl's attributed H1/H2 input. Recommendation B + P0, E1-E4/H1 then R1/R2, 12-20 engineer-days.
